Log In five noun ˈfīv How to pronounce five (audio) plural fives Synonyms of fivenext Simplify Simple definitions use shorter wording to explain meanings more clearly 1 : a number that is one more than four see Table of Numbers 2 fives plural : a British handball game 3 : the fifth in a set or series the five of clubs 4 : something having five units or members especially : a basketball team 5 : a 5-dollar bill 6 : fifteen sense 2 7 : a gesture in which two people slap each other's extended hands (as in greeting or celebration) —usually used in the phrases give one five or slap one five… Ayton stood up and gave him five in celebration.— Duane RankinSo I slapped him five and hugged him.— J. R. Burke five adjective five pronoun, plural in construction see also: high five take five Examples of five in a Sentence I get off work at five. The store is open until five.
